verdicts.why: Mephisto first shows himself to Riri and makes the deal in episode 6, the finale, where Natalie comes back.
The pact is shown in the episode 6 flashback, where Mephisto gives Parker the cloak. Mephisto is not seen before episode 6.
In episode 1 Riri lashes out at her mother Ronnie over the losses. In episode 5 she turns to her mother for help and they reconcile. The split keeps the later facts.
In episode 4 Riri asks Zelma at the shop counter about the cloak fragment, and Zelma takes her to her workshop to examine it. Zelma powers the new suit with magic in episode 5, which the split keeps.
In episode 4 Zelma teleports herself, her mother, Ronnie and Riri to her secret room in the Western Cortex of Neverish to examine the fragment. It is not an escape to safety.
Zelma powers Riri's new suit with magic in episode 5, before the fight with Parker in episode 6.
Claire appears in Jessica Jones only in S1 episode 13, where she helps Jessica with Luke at the hospital.
In S1E7 Jessica visits her adoptive mother Dorothy and warns her, and Dorothy says taking her in was a mistake. The adoption flashback is S1E11, and the split keeps it there.
Dorothy first appears in S1E7, where Jessica warns her to stay away from Trish. The abuse flashbacks are in S1E11, and the split keeps them there.
Costa is not in S1E7 (he first appears in S2E2). The precinct takeover is only told from his side in S2E5, when he tells Jessica about it and says the nightmares stopped when she killed Kilgrave.

value.title: Jessica Jones S2#2
value.text: Will Simpson learns that the IGH killer may go after Trish Walker and tries to protect her. The killer tracks him down at the Greenpoint Stages and kills him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A man trying to protect Trish from her. She kills him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The killer Simpson tries to warn Trish about, who kills him.

verdicts.why: Simpson is killed in S2E2 by a shadowy figure, so the move is right. But the woman is only shown to be Alisa, Jessica's mother, at the end of S2E6, so the S2E2 text and card lines no longer name her.
S2E7 flashbacks show Malus saving Alisa after the crash and caring for her. S2E5 and S2E6 show them as a couple, but she is first named as Alisa at the end of S2E6.

Costa works the killings from S2E2 and S2E5, and in S2E8 Jessica sends him the address of Malus's house and he comes to arrest them. Ruth Sunday is dragged out of the window in S2E12, which the split keeps.

value.title: Jessica Jones S2#2
value.text: Detective Eddy Costa questions Jessica about Robert Coleman's death and suspects her of the killing.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Private investigator Costa suspects of murder.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Detective who suspects Jessica of murder.

split.title: Jessica Jones S2#4
split.text: Detective Eddy Costa arrests Jessica for the murder of Nick Spanos during the IGH killings.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Private investigator Costa arrests for murder.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Detective who arrests Jessica for murder.

split.title: Jessica Jones S2#5
split.text: Costa comes to believe Jessica and lets her go, and he sticks his neck out to work the case with her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Private investigator Costa arrests, then believes. He risks his neck working with her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Detective who arrests Jessica, then believes her and works the case with her.

verdicts.why: Costa and Sunday first question Jessica and suspect her in S2E2, he arrests her in S2E4, and he believes her in S2E5. The proposed S2E4 stage would keep the kind 'ally' for an arrest, so the hostile stages are marked enemy.
In S2E4 Trish shoves Ruth Sunday to get to Jessica while Costa arrests her, and Trish is arrested too. In S3E13 Costa tells Jessica to deal with the vigilante and then reads Trish the charges.

In S2E8 Malcolm continues Jessica's investigation into Hogarth's partners, and Benowitz gives him blackmail material on Chao. The recorded Chao meeting and his work for Hogarth are in S2E13, which the split keeps.
In S3E1 Malcolm still works for Hogarth and is disturbed by how a baseball player's drunk-driving case is handled. The Lyonne digging (S3E3 to S3E4) and his quitting (S3E9) stay in the split.

value.title: Jessica Jones S3#5
value.text: Malcolm takes in Erik's sister Brianna at his place to protect her from Gregory Sallinger, but she soon leaves with her pimp.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The man who takes Brianna in to protect her from Sallinger.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Erik's sister, whom Malcolm takes in to protect from Sallinger.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#6
split.text: Malcolm beats up Brianna's pimp, and she comes back to his place, where the two begin an affair.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The man who beats up Brianna's pimp and begins an affair with her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Erik's sister, who comes back to Malcolm and begins an affair with him.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#10
split.text: Brianna returns sober and asks Malcolm for a second chance. He lets her stay, and the two become lovers.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The man who protects Brianna, then lets her stay. They become lovers.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Malcolm protects, then takes back as his lover.

verdicts.why: S3E5 and S3E6 are right, but the proposed S3E6 split also tells that she returns sober for a second chance, which is S3E10, so that goes in its own stage. In S3E5 he is only protecting her, so that stage is ally, not partner.

value.title: Jessica Jones S3#4
value.text: Erik Gelden senses the darkness in Gregory Sallinger and tries to blackmail him, which makes him one of Sallinger's targets.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Serial killer Erik tries to blackmail.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Man who senses Sallinger's darkness and tries to blackmail him.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#5
split.text: Sallinger ambushes Erik in his room and kidnaps him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Serial killer Erik tries to blackmail, who kidnaps him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Man who tries to blackmail Sallinger and is kidnapped by him.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#6
split.text: Erik survives Sallinger's kidnapping only because Jessica and Trish come to his rescue.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Serial killer Erik tries to blackmail, who later kidnaps him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Man Sallinger kidnaps, saved by Jessica and Trish.

verdicts.why: In S3E4 the bloody bag from mark #3, Sallinger, shows he is after Erik, and Sallinger takes Erik at the end of S3E5. But Jessica and Trish rescue him in S3E6, so the rescue cannot sit in the S3E5 split.
In S3E1 Jessica meets Erik at a bar and takes him back to her apartment. In S3E4 he reveals he can sense people's wrongdoing and works with her, which leads to Sallinger.

value.title: Jessica Jones S3#10
value.text: Erik Gelden watches Trish beat the developer Jace Montero to death in his trailer.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The vigilante Erik watches kill Jace Montero.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A man who watches Trish kill Jace Montero.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#11
split.text: Erik uses his power to help Trish track down criminals, and he goes along with it even after she kills Carl Nussbaumer.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Ally who helps Trish hunt criminals with his power.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#12
split.text: Erik stops helping Trish once she starts killing on purpose, and he helps Jessica and Malcolm trap her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Vigilante Erik helps hunt criminals, until she starts killing them.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Ally who helps Trish hunt criminals, then turns on her when she kills.

verdicts.why: Erik is first seen with Trish at the end of S3E10, when she kills Montero. How she recruited him is only shown in S3E11, and he turns on her and helps trap her in S3E12, so those facts move to later stages.
In S3E4 Jessica finds her attacker, Sallinger, who stabbed her while masked in S3E1. Dorothy's murder (S3E8) and the kidnapping and Trish's killing of him (S3E12) stay in the split.
In S3E7 Malcolm takes on the Sallinger case against Hogarth's wishes, and he and Jessica confront Sallinger at wrestling practice.
In S3E5 Trish stakes out Sallinger and breaks into his apartment for evidence. He murders Dorothy in S3E8 and Trish kills him in S3E12, which the split keeps.

In S1E3 Hogarth arranges for Trish to interview Hope on her radio show. In S1E9 both are at the warehouse and Hogarth secretly cuts the wire, so the split's fix to the earlier 'help hold Kilgrave' text is right.

value.title: Jessica Jones S3#9
value.text: Jeri learns from security footage that Trish is the masked vigilante.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The masked vigilante, whose identity Jeri discovers.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer who learns Trish is the masked vigilante.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#11
split.text: Jeri uses what she knows to manipulate Trish into going after Demetri Patseras for Kith's sake.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The vigilante Jeri manipulates into going after Patseras.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer who manipulates Trish into going after Demetri Patseras.

split.title: Jessica Jones S3#13
split.text: When Trish becomes a fugitive, she takes Jeri's love Kith Lyonne hostage to force Jeri's help.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The vigilante Jeri manipulates, who later takes Kith hostage to force Jeri's help.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer who manipulates Trish, then is forced to help her flee.

verdicts.why: Hogarth sees Trish's face in the unedited footage in S3E9, so the start is right. But she approaches Trish about Patseras in S3E11 and Kith is taken hostage in S3E13, so those facts are split out.
Jessica and Kith only share a scene in S3E13, when Trish takes Kith hostage at Hogarth's home.
Jessica and Luke sleep together in S1E1. He hires her about Reva and learns the truth in S1E6, which the split keeps.
In The Defenders episode 3 Luke bursts into Midland Circle to help Danny, then Jessica and Matt arrive, and all four fight the Hand together.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
value.text: Jessica and Luke are together again and have a daughter named Danielle. Luke does CIA work overseas so that Jessica does not have to.

split.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
split.text: The CIA lets Luke go, and he comes home to Jessica and Danielle.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Jessica's partner again and the father of their daughter, Danielle.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Luke's partner again and the mother of their daughter, Danielle.

verdicts.why: Luke is first named in S2E7, where Mr. Charles says Luke does CIA work so Jones does not have to. But Luke comes home in S2E8, so that part moves to its own stage.
Jessica and Oscar kiss in S2E4 but he stops it. They first sleep together in S2E6, and S2E10 is a later night.
In S1E9 Jessica makes Clemons, handcuffed, watch Kilgrave's power at the warehouse. Simpson kills him while he guards the evidence in S1E10, which the split keeps.
In S2E6 Malcolm recognizes Malus's ring as one from his old college and goes there for Jessica. At the end of S2E10 Trish knocks him out at the motel to go after Malus, which the split keeps.
S1E4 ends with Jessica finding that the photographer spying on her for Kilgrave is Malcolm. The drugs Kilgrave hooked him on come out in S1E5, which the split keeps.
Nothing passes between them until S1E3, when Trish insults Kilgrave on air, he calls in, and he sends Simpson to kill her.
S1E3 shows Jessica killing Reva in flashback and names Luke as her widower, who only knows about the bus. He learns the truth in S1E6, which the split keeps.

In S1E7 Jessica's plan is to get herself sent to Supermax. Malcolm, who disagrees with it, calls Trish and they clean up Ruben's death scene. They do not try to stop her giving herself up to Kilgrave.

value.title: Jessica Jones S2#6
value.text: Malcolm finds Trish's enhancer inhaler and tries to help her, and the two end up sleeping together.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Jessica's sister, who becomes Malcolm's lover.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's friend, who becomes Trish's lover.

split.on_a_card_about_b: Malcolm's lover, who pushes him to the inhaler.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Trish's lover, whom she pushes to the inhaler.

split.title: Jessica Jones S2#10
split.text: Malcolm helps Trish track Karl Malus to a motel, where she knocks him out to take Malus for herself.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Malcolm's lover, who pushes him to the inhaler, then knocks him out.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Trish's lover, whom she pushes to the inhaler, then knocks out.

verdicts.why: They first sleep together in S2E6 and the inhaler push is S2E8. But she knocks him out at the end of S2E10, so that part and its card wording move out of the S2E8 split.
Malcolm protects Trish through S3E9. In S3E12 he and Erik taser her for Jessica, and he keeps her chained in her apartment.
Oscar and Vido move into Jessica's building in S2E1. The forgery record (S2E3), Sonia's custody fight and Jessica saving Vido at her window (S2E4) fit the split.
